sample.rule: every 4th synthetic sentence (all 8 conditions); every 2nd real line

meta.reading: tessdata_best per language, exact mode, beam decode (tessgpu.beam)
meta.new_baseline: tight + flatfield (tessgpu.improve.prepare); views and votes sit on it
meta.improvements_ranked_by: gain vs the new baseline (tight_ff): real, then synthetic
meta.cer: Levenshtein / len(truth) after whitespace collapse (rapidfuzz); real set reported case-sensitive and case-folded
meta.fixed_broken: fixed: reference exact-match is wrong (CER > 0) and arm is exact; broken: reference exact and arm wrong
meta.greedy_objective: mean of real CER and synthetic CER, starting from the new baseline
meta.oracle: views_oracle is a CEILING: it picks by the truth
meta.selection_bias: the combination and the rankings are chosen on the same sample they are reported on; no held-out split

baseline.description: Line as is, scaled to model height, beam-decoded (tessdata_best).

invert.description: Flip the line when ref.needs_invert is true.

pad2.description: Add 2 px background border before scaling.

pad4.description: Add 4 px background border before scaling.

pad8.description: Add 8 px background border before scaling.

stretch.description: Linear stretch of the 2nd..98th percentile to 0..255.

upscale.description: Lines under 20 px: Lanczos straight to model height.

deskew.description: Per-line rotation in +-3 deg maximising row-profile variance.

ens_conf.description: Six variants (pad 2/4/8 x stretch on/off), pick the highest confidence.

ens_rover.description: Same six variants, ROVER-style character voting weighted by confidence.

model_ens.description: tessdata_best and tessdata_fast, pick the highest confidence.

tight.description: Crop to the ink bounding box plus 4 px (ink found after flatfield).

tight_ff.description: NEW BASELINE: tight crop, then flatfield.

view_gamma0.5.description: Photometric view gamma0.5 on the tight+flatfield line.

view_gamma2.description: Photometric view gamma2 on the tight+flatfield line.

view_contrast0.6.description: Photometric view contrast0.6 on the tight+flatfield line.

view_contrast1.5.description: Photometric view contrast1.5 on the tight+flatfield line.

view_otsu.description: Photometric view otsu on the tight+flatfield line.

view_thicken.description: Photometric view thicken on the tight+flatfield line.

view_thin.description: Photometric view thin on the tight+flatfield line.

views_conf.description: New baseline plus all seven views, highest confidence wins.

views_oracle.description: CEILING (uses the truth): per line, the closest of the new baseline and all views.

rover_equal_3.description: ROVER, equal weights, new baseline + gamma0.5 + contrast0.6 (majority of three).

rover_equal_all.description: ROVER, equal weights, new baseline + all seven views.

rover_conf_3.description: ROVER, confidence weights, new baseline + gamma0.5 + contrast0.6.

rover_conf_all.description: ROVER, confidence weights, new baseline + all seven views.

combo.description: Best preprocessing combination, greedy forward selection from the new baseline.

combo+ens_conf.description: Best combination with the six-variant confidence ensemble.

combo+ens_rover.description: Best combination with the six-variant ROVER vote.

combo+model_ens.description: Best combination with the best/fast model ensemble.
